id: 09_Industrial Laser Safety Tips for Non-Laser Operators (and Tourists) Innovative L
title: 非操作人员的激光车间安全
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/09_Industrial Laser Safety Tips for Non-Laser Operators (and Tourists) Innovative L.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/09_Industrial Laser Safety Tips for Non-Laser Operators (and Tourists) Innovative L/src.py

points.K6: 快排放时，别让人站旁边
points.K7: 机前安全地垫：一踩就停
points.K15: 灭火器：带电用二氧化碳
points.K16: 背面没有地垫，用链条拦
points.K17: 背面是维修人员的地方
points.K18: 黄色警示贴：后面有光路
points.K20: 龙门架在动，链条挂着别进
points.S2: 停机后报告，确认再复位

shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光加工车间门口，身后是一台大型激光切割机
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the entrance of a laser workshop with a large laser cutting machine behind it.
shots.narration: 这一课，带不开激光的人逛一圈车间。
overlay: 非操作人员的激光车间安全

shots.scene: 鞋子、储罐、地垫、急停按钮、链条五个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a safety shoe, a cryogenic tank, a floor safety mat, a red emergency stop button, and a barrier chain. No people.
shots.narration: 从门口到机器背面，处处有门道。

shots.scene: 阿杰和几位其他专业的同学来车间参观，好奇地往激光机前凑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and a few students from other majors visit the workshop and crowd toward the front of a laser cutting machine.
shots.narration: 阿杰和同学来参观，都往机器前凑。

shots.scene: 阿杰一脚踩上机前的黑色地垫，机器“嘀”地停了下来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student steps onto a black floor mat in front of the machine and the machine stops with a beep.
shots.narration: 阿杰一脚踩上地垫，机器突然停了。

shots.scene: 老李走过来，笑着指指地垫
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks over, smiles, and points at the floor mat.
shots.narration: 老李说：别慌，这是在保护你。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 车间里还有哪些保护？跟着走一圈。

shots.scene: 老李在车间门口迎接参观的同学
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer welcomes the visiting students at the workshop door.
shots.narration: 大家都想看激光，很欢迎。

shots.scene: 家、办公室和车间三个图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a home, an office, and a busy workshop side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 可车间不是家和办公室，要有人照看。

shots.scene: 老李脚穿安全鞋、身穿长裤、戴安全眼镜
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears safety shoes, long pants, and safety glasses.
shots.narration: 进车间：安全鞋、长裤、安全眼镜。

shots.scene: 同学们在门口戴上安全眼镜
shots.prompt_en: The students put on safety glasses at the workshop door.
shots.narration: 参观的同学，也先戴好眼镜。

shots.scene: 干净的通道，电缆和软管挂在墙上
shots.prompt_en: A clean walkway with cables and hoses hung on wall hooks above the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 通道扫干净，线缆软管离开地面。

shots.scene: 扫帚图标和盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A broom icon next to a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 整理整顿，本身就是安全。

shots.scene: 激光机旁一个压缩空气罐和两个低温储罐
shots.prompt_en: A compressed air tank and two cryogenic liquid tanks next to a laser cutting machine. No people.
shots.narration: 切割用压缩空气、液氮或液氧。

shots.scene: 储罐剖面：外面的热传进去，压力表指针上升
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a cryogenic tank: heat flows in from outside and a pressure gauge needle rises. No people.
shots.narration: 低温液体吸热，罐里压力会升高。

shots.scene: 储罐顶部安全阀嘶嘶冒气
shots.prompt_en: A relief valve on top of the tank hisses and releases a thin stream of gas. No people.
shots.narration: 压力高了，安全阀会嘶嘶排气。

shots.scene: 罐顶阀门一圈结霜
shots.prompt_en: A ring of frost forms around the valves on top of the tank. No people.
shots.narration: 罐顶结霜挂水，说明快要排了。

shots.scene: 罐顶喷出一大团白雾，几个人图标吓得后退
shots.prompt_en: A white vapor cloud bursts from the tank top while several person icons step back startled. No people.
shots.narration: 白雾一喷，没准备的人会吓一跳。

shots.section_title: 快排放时，别让人站旁边
shots.scene: 老李张开手臂，把同学们带离储罐
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer spreads his arms and guides the students away from the tanks.
shots.narration: 看着快要排气，别让人站在旁边。
overlay: 快排放时，别让人站旁边

shots.section_title: 机前安全地垫：一踩就停
shots.scene: 激光切割机前铺着一条黑色安全地垫
shots.prompt_en: A black safety floor mat lies along the front of a large laser cutting machine. No people.
shots.narration: 人人都想凑到机器前面看。
overlay: 机前安全地垫：一踩就停

shots.section_title: 机前安全地垫：一踩就停
shots.scene: 脚踩上地垫，整台机器的运动图标停止
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a foot steps on the safety mat and all motion icons of the machine stop. No people.
shots.narration: 机前有安全地垫，一踩整台机器就停。

shots.section_title: 机前安全地垫：一踩就停
shots.scene: 地垫和盾牌图标连在一起
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the safety mat linked to a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它是保护人的重要装置。

shots.scene: 操作台上一个黄色的进给保持按钮，机器末端也有一个
shots.prompt_en: A yellow feed hold button on the control panel, and another one at the far end of the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 操作台和机器末端，都有快停按钮。

shots.scene: 按下快停，龙门架停住，但指示灯仍亮
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: pressing the feed hold stops the moving gantry while the power indicator lights stay on. No people.
shots.narration: 快停只是让机器停止运动。

shots.scene: 红色蘑菇头急停按钮特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a red mushroom-head emergency stop button. No people.
shots.narration: 急停按钮不一样。

shots.scene: 按下急停，驱动、高压、激光三个图标同时熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: pressing the emergency stop turns off three icons at once: drive motors, high voltage, and laser. No people.
shots.narration: 一按急停，驱动、高压全部断开。

shots.scene: 墙上的总隔离开关箱，旁边是激光电源柜和冷水机
shots.prompt_en: A main disconnect switch box on the wall next to tall laser power cabinets and a chiller. No people.
shots.narration: 还有一个总隔离开关。

shots.scene: 拉下总闸，激光器、冷水机、辅助设备图标全部熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: pulling the main disconnect turns off the laser, the chiller, and all support equipment icons. No people.
shots.narration: 一拉，激光器和辅助设备全断电。

shots.scene: 新手站在机器旁一脸慌张，老李指向总闸
shots.prompt_en: A new student stands confused beside the machine while the facility engineer points to the main disconnect switch.
shots.narration: 出了事故拿不准，就拉总闸。

shots.scene: 工作台边的废料桶，尖角伸到通道上
shots.prompt_en: Scrap buckets at the end of a workbench, with sharp metal edges sticking out into the walkway. No people.
shots.narration: 废料尖角伸出来，走路会被扎。

shots.scene: 人们的视线都朝向发出响声的机器
shots.prompt_en: Eye icons all looking up at noisy machines with sound wave lines. No people.
shots.narration: 大家都看机器，没人看脚下。

shots.scene: 老李把废料桶推到墙边，把电缆挂起
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing gloves, pushes the scrap buckets against the wall and hangs up a cable.
shots.narration: 通道清空，线缆离地。

shots.scene: 格栅切割台上一排排尖尖的支撑条
shots.prompt_en: Rows of pointed support slats on a laser cutting table. No people.
shots.narration: 格栅条又尖又利。

shots.scene: 靠机器、手搭格栅、爬上台面三个图标，都被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: leaning on the machine, resting a hand on the slats, and climbing onto the table. No people.
shots.narration: 不靠机器，不搭格栅，不爬台面。

shots.scene: 一个人在格栅上滑倒的示意图标，旁边急救箱
shots.prompt_en: A simple icon of a person slipping on the slatted table next to a first aid kit icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有人摔在台面上，伤得很重。

shots.scene: 上料台的小滚珠“砰”地升起，背对的人图标一抖
shots.prompt_en: The transfer balls on a loading table pop up with a sound wave while a person icon with their back turned flinches. No people.
shots.narration: 气动滚珠升起时会突然一响。

shots.scene: 废料骨架竖放在架里，链条挂好
shots.prompt_en: Scrap skeleton sheets stand upright in a rack with a chain hooked across the front. No people.
shots.narration: 废料架用链条锁住，倒不下来。

shots.scene: 架顶伸出的板角在头部高度，被切掉
shots.prompt_en: A sheet corner sticking out at head height from the top of a rack is cut off and removed. No people.
shots.narration: 伸到头高的板角，切掉或收好。

shots.section_title: 灭火器：带电用二氧化碳
shots.scene: 门边挂着二氧化碳灭火器，废料架旁有黄色金属火灾灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A carbon dioxide extinguisher hangs by the door and a yellow metal fire extinguisher stands by the scrap rack. No people.
shots.narration: 车间备着两种灭火器。
overlay: 灭火器：带电用二氧化碳

shots.section_title: 灭火器：带电用二氧化碳
shots.scene: 干粉覆盖电路板的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of powder covering a circuit board, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 精密设备喷干粉，残留会腐蚀设备。

shots.section_title: 灭火器：带电用二氧化碳
shots.scene: 二氧化碳罩住火焰后散去，设备干净
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: carbon dioxide covers a flame, then clears away leaving the equipment clean. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳灭火不留残渣，适合带电设备。

shots.section_title: 灭火器：带电用二氧化碳
shots.scene: 钛合金燃烧图标旁是金属火灾灭火器
shots.prompt_en: An icon of burning titanium next to a metal fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 钛等金属着火，用金属火灾灭火器。

shots.section_title: 背面没有地垫，用链条拦
shots.scene: 机器背面的通道口，拦着一条黄黑相间的链条
shots.prompt_en: At the back of the laser machine, a yellow and black chain hangs across the walkway entrance. No people.
shots.narration: 机器背面没有地垫，用链条拦着。
overlay: 背面没有地垫，用链条拦

shots.section_title: 背面没有地垫，用链条拦
shots.scene: 链条图标像一根拉绳，挡住一个人形图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the chain acting like a safety cord, blocking a person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 链条拦住人，不被机器缠住。

shots.section_title: 背面是维修人员的地方
shots.scene: 老李戴着防护眼镜在机器背面做检修
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing laser safety goggles, does maintenance work at the back of the machine.
shots.narration: 背面通常只有维修人员进去。
overlay: 背面是维修人员的地方

shots.section_title: 背面是维修人员的地方
shots.scene: 老李对着反射镜座做光路校准
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer adjusts a mirror mount during beam alignment with the machine housing open.
shots.narration: 他们在这里校准光路。

shots.section_title: 黄色警示贴：后面有光路
shots.scene: 示意图：光束从激光柜射出，经几面反射镜转到切割头
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a beam leaves the laser cabinet, bounces off several mirrors, and travels to the cutting head. No people.
shots.narration: 激光在柜里产生，经反射镜送到切割头。
overlay: 黄色警示贴：后面有光路

shots.section_title: 黄色警示贴：后面有光路
shots.scene: 光路护罩上贴着黄色激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: Yellow laser warning signs on the metal covers of the beam path. No people.
shots.narration: 护罩上的黄色警示贴，就在提醒这个。

shots.section_title: 黄色警示贴：后面有光路
shots.scene: 揭开护罩的图标，后面露出一道光束
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a beam path cover being removed, revealing a beam behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 揭开护罩，后面就可能有激光。

shots.scene: 一束看不见的光，只用虚线表示，眼睛图标打问号
shots.prompt_en: An invisible beam shown only as a dotted line, with an eye icon and a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这种激光是红外光，眼睛看不见。

shots.scene: 虚线光束打到纸箱上，纸箱冒烟起火
shots.prompt_en: The dotted invisible beam hits a cardboard box, which starts to smoke and catch fire. No people.
shots.narration: 它射到哪里，哪里就可能起火。

shots.scene: 非维修人员伸手揭护罩的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an untrained person removing a beam cover, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 护罩只由懂行的维修人员按规程打开。

shots.section_title: 龙门架在动，链条挂着别进
shots.scene: 背面导轨上，龙门架带着风琴管来回移动
shots.prompt_en: At the back, the gantry slides back and forth along a rail with a folding bellows cover. No people.
shots.narration: 背面的龙门架一直在来回移动。
overlay: 龙门架在动，链条挂着别进

shots.section_title: 龙门架在动，链条挂着别进
shots.scene: 检修面板和气管接口在背面
shots.prompt_en: Service panels and air connections on the back side of the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 检修面板在这里，需要时才进。

shots.section_title: 龙门架在动，链条挂着别进
shots.scene: 链条挂起，旁边一个禁止进入标志
shots.prompt_en: The chain hangs across the walkway with a no entry sign beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 链条挂着，就是不得进入。

shots.scene: 王老师带新同学认急停按钮和总闸的位置
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shows new students where the emergency stop buttons and the main disconnect are.
shots.narration: 进车间第一课，先认急停和总闸。

shots.scene: 急停按钮和总闸前堆着杂物的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of boxes blocking an emergency stop button and a main disconnect switch, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 前面不能挡，伸手就能够到。

shots.section_title: 停机后报告，确认再复位
shots.scene: 阿杰按下急停后，立刻给老李打电话
shots.prompt_en: After pressing the emergency stop, the young male student immediately calls the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 按了急停、拉了总闸，马上报告。
overlay: 停机后报告，确认再复位

shots.section_title: 停机后报告，确认再复位
shots.scene: 老李检查确认后，才把急停复位
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the machine, then resets the emergency stop button.
shots.narration: 查明原因、负责人确认，才能复位。

shots.section_title: 停机后报告，确认再复位
shots.scene: 自己随手复位重启的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand casually resetting and restarting the machine, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要自己随手复位开机。

shots.scene: 一束光射向眼睛的示意图标，旁边感叹号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a beam reaching an eye with an exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 万一眼睛被激光照到，

shots.scene: 阿杰捂着眼睛，小研马上关掉激光并报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student covers his eye while the female graduate student switches off the laser and reports.
shots.narration: 立刻停激光，报告老师，别揉眼睛。

shots.scene: 电话图标显示120，旁边医院图标
shots.prompt_en: A phone icon showing 120 next to a hospital icon. No people.
shots.narration: 尽快到医院眼科检查，必要时拨120。

shots.scene: 老李摘下手表和戒指，放进盒子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer takes off his watch and ring and puts them in a small box.
shots.narration: 调光路时，先摘下手表、戒指。

shots.scene: 反光的金属工具把光束反射到旁边的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a shiny metal tool reflecting a beam sideways, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 反光的东西，会把光打到意想不到的地方。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现安全鞋、地垫、急停、总闸、链条五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside five icons: a safety shoe, a safety mat, an emergency stop, a main disconnect switch, and a barrier chain.
shots.narration: 穿戴好，认地垫、急停和总闸。

shots.scene: 储罐、废料架、灭火器、警示贴四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a cryogenic tank, a chained scrap rack, a fire extinguisher, and a yellow laser warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 储罐远一点，废料锁好，灭火器选对。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在链条外，看着机器背面的警示贴
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands outside the chain, looking at the yellow warning signs on the back of the machine.
shots.narration: 链条挂着不进，警示贴后有激光。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、老李、王老师在车间门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the young male student, the facility engineer and the safety administrator at the workshop door.
shots.narration: 不开激光，也要懂激光车间。
